Zincum Bromatum.

Bromide of Zinc. Zincic bromide. ZnBr2. Solution.

Clinical.─Chorea. Dentition. Hydrocephalus.

Characteristics.─Hale has used Zn. br. on its double indications for teething children who suffer intensely from pain in nerves of head and face, pains which throw the children into a state of stupor alternating with wakefulness. He uses the 3rd and 6th attenuations.
